# device42_building (Resource)


## Exemple 

```hcl
resource "device42_building" "myNewBuilding" {
    name           = "myNewBuilding"
    address        = "100 Main Street, New York"
    contact_name   = "John Doe"
    contact_phone  = "+1 555 000 000"
    notes          = "Main Data Center building"
    tags           = "Prod,East"
    custom_fields  = {
        "building_type" = "data_center"
    }
}
```



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the building. ForceNew.

### Optional

- `address` (String) Address of the building.
- `contact_name` (String) Contact name of the building.
- `contact_phone` (String) Contact phone of the building.
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Any custom fields that will be used in device42.
- `groups` (String) Admin groups that have access to this building (multitenancy), e.g. Prod_East:no,Corp:yes.
- `latitude` (String) North-south position.
- `longitude` (String) East-west position.
- `notes` (String) Any additional notes.
- `tags` (String) Add or update tags to a building (comma separated).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `building_id` (Number) ID of the building.

### Import

Building resources can be imported using the building name, e.g.

```bash
$ terraform import device42_building.myNewBuilding myNewBuilding
```
